signature: SUBROUTINE DLALN2( LTRANS, NA, NW, SMIN, CA, A, LDA, D1, D2, B,

params.name: ltrans
params.reference: =.TRUE.: A-transpose will be used. =.FALSE.: A will be used (not transposed.)

params.name: na
params.reference: The size of the matrix A. It may (only) be 1 or 2.

params.name: nw
params.reference: 1 if "w" is real, 2 if "w" is complex. It may only be 1 or 2.

params.name: smin
params.reference: The desired lower bound on the singular values of A. This should be a safe distance away from underflow or overflow, say, between (underflow/machine precision) and (machine precision \* overflow ). (See BIGNUM and ULP.)

params.name: ca
params.reference: The coefficient c, which A is multiplied by.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of A. It must be at least `NA`.

params.name: d1
params.reference: The 1,1 element in the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: d2
params.reference: The 2,2 element in the diagonal matrix D. Not used if `NA=1`.

params.name: B
params.reference: The `NA` x `NW` matrix B (right-hand side). If `NW=2` ("w" is complex), column 1 contains the real part of B and column 2 contains the imaginary part.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of B. It must be at least `NA`.

params.name: wr
params.reference: The real part of the scalar "w".

params.name: wi
params.reference: The imaginary part of the scalar "w". Not used if `NW=1`.

params.name: X
params.reference: The `NA` x `NW` matrix X (unknowns), as computed by DLALN2. If `NW=2` ("w" is complex), on exit, column 1 will contain the real part of X and column 2 will contain the imaginary part.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of X. It must be at least `NA`.

params.name: scale
params.reference: The scale factor that B must be multiplied by to insure that overflow does not occur when computing X. Thus, (ca A - w D) X will be $\mathrm{SCALE} \, B$, not B (ignoring perturbations of A.) It will be at most 1.

params.name: xnorm
params.reference: The infinity-norm of X, when X is regarded as an `NA` x `NW` real matrix.

params.name: info
params.reference:
An error flag. It will be set to zero if no error occurs, a negative number if an argument is in error, or a positive number if ca A - w D had to be perturbed. The possible values are:

-   `= 0`: No error occurred, and (ca A - w D) did not have to be perturbed.
-   `= 1`: (ca A - w D) had to be perturbed to make its smallest (or only) singular value greater than `SMIN`. NOTE: In the interests of speed, this routine does not check the inputs for errors.
